_doc: PROPOSAL (task M3-01, second run), not game data. The five pollution kinds (spec section 2). tool: the id Lumi must own to work the kind at all ('' = none). needs_module and without_module_factor: a rig module the kind wants; without it fitted Lumi works the kind at that factor (slick without the Hover Skirt is shoreline work only). hand_factor: Lumi's rate on the kind against litter. loads: true = the work goes through the chest (tip or press, then paid per load); false = paid as it is done, with a small win every `batch` units (in the game every kind ends as bales Lumi presses and sells; the flag only sets how the handling time is modelled). yield: cubes and Parts per unit cleared BY HAND; cubes 'kept:pollution' means the average value of the planet's current junk table, read through Planets. The cube yields are relative: each city scales them so one hex is worth its hex_cubes (districts.json). The Parts yields are per unit of a hex of districts.json parts_ref_work units; litter in district 1 gives about 0.8 Parts a hex and wrecks are where Parts open up. Robots earn nothing: no cubes and no Parts from their cleaning (the crew's Parts come from Scroungers digging the cleaned ground, robots.json chain). seeds_per_hex: seeds it costs to clear this kind from one hex (blight is cleared with cleansing plants, by Lumi or by Seedlings: decision 16.9). mastery_per_unit and mastery_level1_units: level L needs mastery_level1_units x balance.mastery.growth^(L-1) units cleared by hand.
